Four judges scored every result in one shuffled list, solved and open together, so the points compare directly. 100 points is the median solved result, and there is no ceiling. An open result is scored by what it would be worth if achieved and checked. The thin line on a bar runs from the lowest to the highest judge. Every 10 net votes doubles or halves a result's points, up to 8 times either way.
